note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/sign-in.reason: cinatra#2396 (PR #2401): the versioned additive batch-v2 contract adds ONE new pure module, packages/llm/src/batch-v2.ts — the single provider-neutral normalization layer (request validation + per-provider sanitization, the v1-canonical Chat-Completions body builder, status/state/outcome normalization, and the stable batch error-code mapping) — reached through the PRE-EXISTING @cinatra-ai/llm barrel edge (packages/llm/src/index.ts) that every locked route already carries. Keeping the new leaf OFF the locked routes was weighed and found to cost something real in every form: the v2-preferring wrappers in index.ts CALL these helpers at runtime, so no type-only (erased) edge is available; dropping the edge while keeping the ratified root surface AND the isolated leaf would require a second @cinatra-ai/llm/batch-v2 entrypoint — an unratified split of the batch surface (the v1 dispatch stays on the barrel) pushing every consumer of the #2396 contract onto a second import path; folding the 460 lines into an already-counted module (the 2074-line index.ts barrel) would hold the count flat but give up the isolated leaf seam — packages/llm/src/batch-v2.test.ts would have to drive the helpers through the barrel — and would swell an unrelated module, which is exactly the re-derivation/inlining the S2 precedent rejects; and a lazy dynamic import was rejected outright as trading static analyzability for a green check. One shared single-definition module, one extra edge, +1 on every locked route. Supersedes this route's #2377 record (1666 -> 1667, the shared open-redirect validator on the pre-existing auth-session edge), which this raise retires.
